deviations: Grant script src/sql/grants/MOD-015.sql uses the placeholder role [<analyst_role>] (as MOD-014 does), because the analyst role's name is not known. A human replaces it and runs the script.

DES-001 does not define the four reports' interface. They are built to the interface in ASM-007 (Product Owner answer, unreviewed): one @as_of_date parameter, one aggregate result set each, and the columns, bases and measures stated there.
notes:
Four count-only report procedures in MIG-0021 (REQ-014, RULE-066 to RULE-070). There are no loads, no tables and no audit logging. Starting point: all 17 tests in test_MOD015 failed (procedures missing). Now 17/17 pass, plus 8 dev unit tests.
Choices the Tester's suite does not pin down (each covered by a test_MOD015_dev test):
- Both coverage reports accept @as_of_date and ignore it (including NULL). Payment method coverage drops event rows before 2021 as well as paid positions.
- Invoiced subtotal coverage counts an event with NULL amount_status in `events` but in none of the six status columns.
- Direct Debit share: Direct Debit is payment method id 1, matched by id. Corporate in the totals is payer type id 2. Both are fixed by the seeds. A Partially Paid position with no attributes row counts in the denominator, as not Direct Debit. With no Partially Paid positions the report still returns one row: (year, 0, 0, NULL).
- Missing config year: direct_debit_share fails with THROW 50014 when no Campaign Year covers the date, and last_full_year_totals does the same when there is no earlier year. 50014 is the number usp_report_top_employers already uses (50015 is taken by the bootstrap).
- Last full year totals with no paid members and no events: corporate_paid_members is 0, while corporate_share_pct and both amount totals are NULL.
- Per-category rows include the reserved categories (Unknown, Not applicable). They are grouped by name and joined to the silv_ref_* lists.
Round-trip and check pass. The sqlfluff findings are advisory style points only.

Test-first: the first run had 0 of 17 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 17 of 17 and 8 unit test(s), in 3 run(s).
